leftEvidence.title: John identifies Jesus by a descending and remaining Spirit

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: John calls Jesus God’s Lamb, says Jesus ranks before him, and explains that the purpose of his water baptism was Israel’s recognition.
points.right: John again identifies Jesus as God’s Lamb, two disciples follow, and Andrew brings Simon.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: John testifies that he saw the Spirit descend and remain, receiving that sign from the one who sent him.
points.right: Jesus receives the followers, invites them to see, and gives Simon the name Cephas.

payload.posture: John’s testimony is repeated and two disciples begin following Jesus.

rightEvidence.title: John’s testimony sends disciples after Jesus

payload.tension: Recognition by the witness and response by hearers remain distinct actions.
payload.title: The sign becomes a path of following
